name: Margit, The Fell Omen
description: A powerful demigod who guards the entrance to Stormveil Castle. Margit is one of the first major challenges faced by Tarnished seeking to claim the Elden Ring.

name: Godrick the Grafted
description: A demigod and descendant of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Godrick grafts the limbs of fallen warriors onto his body to gain their strength.

name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
description: Once the head of the Carian royal family and a master sorceress, Rennala was shattered by the loss of her Erdleaf when her husband Radagon left her.
drops: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, Great Rune of the Unborn
